  • Method Details

    • restore

      public Boolean restore()
      Restores this backup. The restore endpoint is keyed by the backup uuid only, so the restore always targets the device this backup was taken from; there is no way to choose a different target device.

      restore. The restore endpoint identifies the target by this backup's uuid; the backup name is sent in the body as required by the API.

      Specified by:

      @Deprecated public Boolean restoreToDevice(String deviceUuid)
